seoTitle: Lord of the Rings Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Lord of the Rings test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Frodo, Sam, Pippin, Gandalf, Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli or Boromir — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the loyal friend, the wise wizard, or the one who can't resist a shortcut? Answer 12 everyday questions about friendship, courage and temptation, and find out which member of the Fellowship you are.

characters.name: Frodo Baggins
characters.title: The Quiet Burden-Bearer
characters.summary: Gentle, thoughtful and braver than you look. You carry more than people realise.
description: Like Frodo, you step up when nobody else will. The hobbit from Bag End volunteered to take the One Ring to Mordor while everyone else at the council was arguing.
You're gentle, thoughtful and quietly stubborn. He loved his peaceful life in the Shire, but he kept going long after anyone else would have stopped.
Your weakness is trying to carry it all alone. Frodo tried to leave the Fellowship behind to protect them, and it took Sam to remind him he didn't have to go alone.
characters.flaw: You try to carry every burden on your own.
characters.signature: A worn map, an old book and a weight you don't talk about.
characters.clashReason: they keep their troubles to themselves, even when you want to help

characters.name: Samwise Gamgee
characters.title: The Loyal Friend
characters.summary: Practical, humble and loyal to the end. You'd follow your friends anywhere.
description: Like Sam, you're the most loyal friend anyone could have. The gardener from the Shire followed Frodo all the way to Mount Doom, and carried him up the mountain when he couldn't walk any further.
You're practical, humble and happiest at home. Give you a garden, a cooking pot and your friends, and you're set.
You don't think of yourself as a hero, but you are. You keep going when everyone else gives up, because somebody has to.
characters.flaw: You never give yourself enough credit.
characters.signature: A frying pan, a little box of salt and a friend you'll never leave behind.
characters.clashReason: they'll follow you everywhere and worry about you constantly

characters.name: Pippin Took
characters.title: The Curious Troublemaker
characters.summary: Fun, hungry and far too curious. You bring the chaos, and the laughs.
description: Like Pippin, you bring the fun, and sometimes the trouble. The youngest hobbit in the Fellowship is curious, always hungry and forever touching things he shouldn't.
You act first and think later. Pippin set off a racket in the Mines of Moria and looked into a dangerous seeing-stone because he simply had to know.
But you grow up fast when it counts. He swore to serve Gondor, and fetched the help that saved Faramir's life.
characters.flaw: Your curiosity gets you into trouble before your brain can stop it.
characters.signature: A pint, a second breakfast and the question nobody wanted asked.
characters.clashReason: they're chaotic, noisy and always getting you into trouble

characters.name: Gandalf
characters.title: The Wise Guide
characters.summary: Patient, wise and a little mysterious. People come to you when they don't know what to do.
description: Like Gandalf, you're the wise one people turn to. The wizard guided the Fellowship, and faced down a Balrog on a bridge in Moria so the others could escape.
You're patient, thoughtful and hard to read. You give people advice, then trust them to make their own choices.
You're more fun than people expect. Gandalf's fireworks were the talk of the Shire. But fools can test your patience very quickly.
characters.flaw: You keep things to yourself until the very last moment.
characters.signature: A grey cloak, a staff and fireworks for special occasions.
characters.clashReason: they always seem to know more than they're telling you

characters.name: Aragorn
characters.title: The Reluctant Leader
characters.summary: Steady, humble and good in a crisis. People follow you without being told to.
description: Like Aragorn, you lead without needing to be in charge. The Ranger known as Strider was heir to the throne of Gondor, but spent years avoiding it.
You're steady, humble and at your best when things go wrong. People follow you because you'd never ask them to do something you wouldn't do yourself.
Your weakness is doubt. Aragorn feared he'd fail the way his ancestor Isildur did. When he finally stepped up, he became the king everyone needed.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself long after everyone else believes in you.
characters.signature: A worn cloak, a campfire and a sword that was broken and made whole again.
characters.clashReason: they're so serious and humble that you can't get them to relax

characters.name: Legolas
characters.title: The Cool Head
characters.summary: Calm, sharp-eyed and hard to rattle. You spot trouble first and deal with it without a fuss.
description: Like Legolas, you stay calm when everyone else is panicking. The elf prince from Mirkwood has the sharpest eyes in the Fellowship and never seems to break a sweat.
You're graceful, quietly confident and happiest outdoors. He's the one who sees trouble coming and handles it without any drama.
Your competitive side only comes out with friends. His running score with Gimli at Helm's Deep turned an old rivalry into one of the best friendships in the story.
characters.flaw: You can seem distant, as if nothing really gets to you.
characters.signature: A bow, perfect hair and the view from the highest point around.
characters.clashReason: they stay so calm and cool that you can't tell what they're feeling

characters.name: Gimli
characters.title: The Proud Warrior
characters.summary: Loud, proud and loyal to the end. You love a feast, a fight and a good argument.
description: Like Gimli, you're loud, proud and fiercely loyal. The dwarf joined the Fellowship to protect Frodo, and ended up best friends with an elf.
You love a feast, a good argument and a bit of friendly competition. You also hate being underestimated.
You're stubborn and quick to take offence. But once someone earns your respect, as Galadriel did, you never forget it.
characters.flaw: You take offence fast and hold a grudge even longer.
characters.signature: An axe, a loud laugh and a running score of who's winning.
characters.clashReason: they're loud, stubborn and turn everything into a competition

characters.name: Boromir
characters.title: The Proud Protector
characters.summary: Brave, proud and devoted to home. You'd do anything to protect your people.
description: Like Boromir, you'd do anything to protect the people you love. The son of Gondor's Steward came to Rivendell looking for a way to save his city.
You're brave, proud and a natural soldier. You want to act now, not talk about it.
Your pride is your weakness. He was tempted by the Ring and tried to take it from Frodo, then died defending Merry and Pippin to make up for it.
characters.flaw: Your wish to protect people can turn into wanting control.
characters.signature: A great horn, a shield and a hard lesson learned.
characters.clashReason: they're proud, pushy and sure their way is the only way

questions.text: Your group can't agree where to go on holiday. You...

options.text: Listen to everyone, then make the call yourself
Argue loudly for your pick until they give in
Pick whichever place has the best food
Quietly hope they pick somewhere close to home

questions.text: A friend asks for your advice, then does the exact opposite. You...

options.text: Let them learn. You've said your piece
Tell them again, louder, until they listen
Help them clean up when it goes wrong
Shrug. It's their life

questions.text: The sun's out and you've got three days off. You...

options.text: Work in the garden, then cook a big dinner
Go hiking somewhere with a view
Have a long brunch, then head to the pub with friends
Curl up with a book about somewhere far away

questions.text: You're offered a job way above your experience. You...

options.text: Take it, even though it terrifies you
Suggest someone more qualified instead
Grab it. You've been waiting for a chance like this
Say yes before you've thought it through

questions.text: Your friends want to take a shortcut that looks like a bad idea. You...

options.text: Go first. Shortcuts are an adventure
Take the long way round. You'll still get there first
Stick close to your best friend, whichever way they go
Keep the group together. Splitting up is how people get lost

questions.text: You find something valuable that isn't yours. You...

options.text: Keep it safe and tell no one until you know what to do
Think about keeping it. For quite a long time
Leave it where it is. Some things are more trouble than they're worth
Hand it in straight away

questions.text: Someone you've never got on with ends up on your team. You...

options.text: Turn it into a friendly competition
Stay cool. They'll come round eventually
Make it clear who's in charge
Crack a joke to break the ice

questions.text: You're hosting and the dinner goes wrong. You...

options.text: Fix it. You can make a good meal out of almost anything
Eat whatever's left and enjoy it anyway
Turn it into a party nobody will forget
Order takeaway and open more drinks

questions.text: Someone keeps putting your friend down behind their back. You...

options.text: Defend them calmly, without making a scene
Confront them to their face, loudly
Say one thing so sharp they never try it again
Give them the benefit of the doubt. Maybe they're struggling

questions.text: You get lost on a hike and your phone's dead. You...

options.text: Use the sun and the trail to work out where you are
Climb something high and look for a landmark
Stop and think. Rushing is how people get more lost
Keep walking. You'll get there one step at a time

questions.text: You're on a quest to destroy a dangerous weapon. A friend wants to use it to defend their home instead. You...

options.text: Agree. Why waste something that could save your people?
Refuse. It'll corrupt whoever uses it
Talk them down, then keep a close eye on them
Suggest smashing it right now and ending the argument

questions.text: You're on a dangerous journey with your friends when you're surrounded and outnumbered. You...

options.text: Plant your feet and fight. They'll have to get through you
Hold them off so the others can get away
Rally everyone and lead the charge
Slip away alone, so nobody else gets hurt because of you
